known_traps: Trust signals are evidence, never usage or rank input.
Maker identity is weighted by operations or credits and must never derive from spend.
Missing profiles return 404; backend failures must remain observable and rethrow.
Optional rollout tables may degrade only with a VTRS warning breadcrumb.
Adjacent comparison windows must be non-overlapping and anchored to the latest real usage day.
